experiment: paired vanilla static production build versus React production build browser measurements
cache: Chromium HTTP cache disabled and cleared before every navigation; one context reused so storage remains isolated to this experiment.

liveReleasePrograms.name: Электромобили и транспортно-технологические средства с комбинированными энергоустановками

catalogScale.source: Synthetic catalog-only rows cloned from one live API program and renamed with unique QA identities; admission and curriculum facts are not asserted.

methodology.readyMs: PerformanceNavigationTiming.startTime to the first visible screen-specific comparison content; for Vanilla, admission may still be loading
methodology.fullDataReadyMs: For compare-load only: Vanilla waits for admission to settle successfully and its comparison table to be visible; React waits for the expected active-release key and an admission summary with zero unavailable selected programs. A sample is retained only if both apps also prove the same release, actual selected verified plan keys, exact curriculum item counts, and numeric hours/credits totals against independent PostgreSQL-backed API fixture sums. Each paginated collection must retain the same release identity.
methodology.comparisonIdentity: Each measured sample records the same two external program keys, verified study-plan keys, release key, exact expected/actual curriculum row counts, and expected/actual numeric hours and credits; any missing row, mismatched plan, release, or aggregate fails the sample.
methodology.actionMs: catalog fill to the single matching QA code becoming visible; synthetic catalog sizes are 50, 100, and 500 rows
methodology.scriptBytes: sum of ResourceTiming encodedBodySize (or transferSize fallback) for every loaded .js/.mjs resource; cache disabled for each measured navigation
methodology.transferredResourceBytes: navigation transferSize plus encodedBodySize (or transferSize fallback) for all resource entries; cache disabled for each measured navigation and API response bodies are included
methodology.apiResourceTimings: Resource Timing duration, transferSize, encodedBodySize, and decodedBodySize for each /api/v1/ response; durations are browser-observed request/response spans
methodology.apiServerTiming: When ACADEMIC_DATA_PROFILE_REQUESTS=1, each API response records FastAPI request/serialization duration, SQLAlchemy cursor round-trip duration/count, and Content-Length; SQL duration is driver-observed elapsed time, not PostgreSQL executor-only time
methodology.comparisonStages: opt-in performance.mark/measure around catalog, selection, plans, items, taxonomy, curriculum-model, admission, final release verification, and total loader time; enabled only in paired React comparison benchmark navigations
methodology.longTasks: PerformanceObserver longtask count and total duration during the page visit; Chromium support only
methodology.cumulativeLayoutShift: sum of layout-shift values without recent user input during the page visit
methodology.jsHeapUsedBytes: Chromium performance.memory snapshot after screen readiness; non-standard and reported as null when unsupported
methodology.note: Vanilla is served from apps/web/dist and React from Vite production preview; browser and API are shared, and data requests use the isolated PostgreSQL 16 seed.
